verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a comprehensive public REST-style API surface (Query API, Raw Event Export API, Engage API, Feature Flags API, JQL) plus a hosted MCP server that lets AI assistants query events, funnels, retention, and replays via natural language, giving AI-native users both programmatic and agentic access. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server or APIs actually working reliably.
